Independent student project; not an official university app. Timetable requests use only HTTPS to nodarbibas.turiba.lv. No accounts, analytics, ads, university credentials or remote logs. Settings and cache stay in app internal storage; cloud backup is disabled. Local storage is not claimed to be encrypted. Background timing depends on Android and battery restrictions.
